notes: All six packet elements are consumed; this package provides none of them, so declares and not_declared are empty. msg:moveit_msgs/GetKinematicSolverInfo has no port and no reference: a grep of the whole snapshot finds no mention of it, and neither srv/GetKinematicSolverInfo.srv nor msg/GetKinematicSolverInfo.msg exists at moveit_msgs 0.9.1 (HTTP 404). GetPositionFK and GetPositionIK are ROS 1 services (srv files); the code only #includes their headers (ur_moveit_plugin.h:87-88) and creates no service client or server, so their ports record a compile-time dependency, and frame is null because nothing in the code uses the request header. The other three types are used in-process through the MoveIt kinematics plugin C++ API (pluginlib class ur_kinematics::URKinematicsPlugin, base kinematics::KinematicsBase), not over topics; JointLimits comes from JointModel getVariableBoundsMsg() (cpp:223). The MoveItErrorCodes constants used are NO_IK_SOLUTION (cpp:570), TIMED_OUT (cpp:609) and SUCCESS (cpp:734). JointLimits units: null. The definition states no units, and the code both wraps the first six joints' limits by 2*M_PI (cpp:666-674, implying radians) and collects prismatic joints' limits (cpp:220). QoS is null throughout (ROS 1). No exclusive resources are declared. package.xml does not list moveit_msgs as a build or run dependency even though the header includes moveit_msgs headers directly; it arrives transitively via moveit_core.
